title: Michael's right arm weak since the abduction

tellings.quote: Just after his abduction, Michael noticed that his right arm was sore.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells the story of an Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson, who says he was abducted by aliens in 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. According to Michels, just after the abduction Michael noticed his right arm was sore, and it has stayed weak ever since. If true, it would be a lasting physical mark left by the encounter.
